subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The Svalbard Global Seed Vault in Norway is one of the world's most important conservation facilities.
• It was established in 2008 with the goal of safeguarding agricultural biodiversity for future generations.
• Scientists at the vault collect seed samples from crops around the world and freeze them at subzero temperatures.
• Preserved seeds include varieties of wheat from Ethiopia, rice from the Philippines, and corn from Mexico.
• The vault uses specialized refrigeration technology to maintain temperatures of -18°C to ensure long-term viability.
prompt: The student wants to explain how the Svalbard Global Seed Vault safeguards agricultural biodiversity. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The Svalbard Global Seed Vault is known for bringing together crop varieties from around the world, including from Ethiopia, the Philippines, and Mexico.
choices.B: Established in Norway in 2008, the Svalbard Global Seed Vault employs many scientists as seed preservation specialists.
choices.C: Seed varieties from Ethiopian wheat, Philippine rice, and Mexican corn are preserved at the Svalbard Global Seed Vault.
choices.D: The Svalbard Global Seed Vault collects seed samples from different countries and uses specialized refrigeration to freeze them for long-term preservation.

explanation: Choice D is the best answer. The sentence explains how the Svalbard Global Seed Vault safeguards agricultural biodiversity, noting that the facility collects, freezes, and preserves seed samples from different countries using specialized technology.
